Boundaries n=2 and all adjacent pairs are covered. The standalone exact Python script was actually executed on the package content after packaging. Finite checks are corroboration only.

value.rationale: This is a sharp complete cross-covariance classification for two natural families of all pairwise ranking decisions. Its rank-two and canonical-correlation formulation identifies the exact shared L2 information and all remaining orthogonal contrasts, beyond existing marginal/aggregate two-sided Eulerian counts. The object is motivated by finite-sample agreement of rankings with inverse rankings; no arbitrary parameter restriction or unmotivated finite enumeration is introduced.
